meta.study_region: Chennai Metropolitan Region, Tamil Nadu, India
meta.primary_dataset: Chennai Metropolitan Region Synthetic Traffic Dataset

data_classification.zone_characteristics: DOMAIN KNOWLEDGE — publicly available land-use info
data_classification.festival_multipliers: SYNTHETIC ASSUMPTIONS — calibrated from news/official reports
data_classification.weather_effects: SYNTHETIC ASSUMPTIONS — based on transport research literature
data_classification.traffic_volumes: SYNTHETIC — generated from demand curves + noise
data_classification.weather_series: SYNTHETIC — generated from IMD climatological normals

meta.note: ALL traffic records are SYNTHETIC / RESEARCH-GROUNDED. No continuous real-time sensor data is available. The system uses documented zone characteristics, behavioural demand curves, and research-calibrated multipliers to produce academically defensible synthetic data for demonstration purposes.

zones.description: Largest intercity bus terminal in Asia. High intercity + local demand.
Planned residential township with significant commercial activity.
Major commercial junction; Arcot Road is a busy arterial.
One of India's busiest retail destinations. Festival shopping surge documented.
Industrial estate + Anna University. NH48/GST Road passes through.
IT and residential mix; MRTS/metro connectivity. Heavy morning/evening commute.
Affluent residential zone; significant office commute on LB Road.
Prime IT corridor on OMR. One of India's highest office density stretches.
Northern residential and dairy zone; commuters to Chennai city.
Western gateway; NH48 (Bangalore corridor) passes through.
Major suburb and railway junction. Commuter hub for southern Chennai.
New southern Chennai bus terminus; intercity + GST Road throughput.
Zoo corridor on GST Road; important throughput node for southern travel.
Suburban residential growth corridor near GST Road.
Major SEZ/industrial hub (Samsung, Foxconn etc.); shift-based patterns.
Northern residential and water-body corridor; commuter zone.
Petrochemical industrial zone; heavy vehicle traffic, shift patterns.
